body: I also encountered the same problem, and it took longer to display the prompt “Done in *s”, but in fact nothing happened. Sometimes switching networks may succeed. The strange thing is that there is no error message. This is very confusing.
hmm. i worried that we may have had problems because of serving assets from GH Releases - thanks for the reporting. going to talk with the team and see about figuring out a more reliable alternative.
Sounds like an issue with the init command, and not with the CLI downloading.
Does `yarn tauri into` prints the message correctly? I guess it's only on the init cmd.

Do you have a project you are installing into?
i.e.
```
git init
yarn init
yarn tauri init
```

The easiest way to reproduce is to cut off the network and run `yarn tauri init`. And I found the problem：

https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/4339b46e4bedc27f943db296ef5d89674046ca0e/tooling/cli.js/src/helpers/download-binary.ts#L42-L45

Throw statement in the catch callback will not be thrown out, we need try-catch to handle it.
New PR has been submitted #2116 

------------edit--------------
I was wrong, await a rejected promise is fine. 

https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/4339b46e4bedc27f943db296ef5d89674046ca0e/tooling/cli.js/src/helpers/download-binary.ts#L22-L31

Meybe it's because `removeDownloadedCliIfNeeded()` just exit the process before error thrown.

issue.title: [win10] Crash after running, exception: STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION

repository.name: tauri
repository.description: Build smaller, faster, and more secure desktop and mobile applications with a web frontend.

issue.body:
I tried to execute `yarn tauri dev` command, or `yarn tauri build` command and then run app_name.exe from `target/release`, both encountered the following issue: the window appears 2 seconds after the crash exit, the window appears during the white screen, no normal web page content is displayed.

```
$ yarn tauri dev 
yarn run v1.22.10
$ tauri dev
 app:spawn Running "C:\Users\xxx\source\repos\tauri_demo\node_modules\@tauri-apps\cli\bin\tauri-cli.exe tauri dev" +0ms

   Compiling app v0.1.0 (C:\Users\xxx\source\repos\tauri_demo\src-tauri)
    Finished dev [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 10.63s
     Running `target\debug\app.exe`
error: process didn't exit successfully: `target\debug\app.exe` (exit code: 0xc0000005, STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION)
```

Environment info:
```
Operating System - Windows, version 10.0.19042 X64
Webview2 - 91.0.864.64

Node.js environment
  Node.js - 14.17.3
  @tauri-apps/cli - 1.0.0-beta.5
  @tauri-apps/api - 1.0.0-beta.4

Global packages
  npm - 6.14.13
  yarn - 1.22.10

Rust environment
  rustc - 1.53.0
  cargo - 1.53.0

App directory structure
/node_modules
/src-tauri
/src-web

App
  tauri.rs - 1.0.0-beta.4
  build-type - bundle
  CSP - default-src blob: data: filesystem: ws: wss: http: https: tauri: 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline' 'self' img-src: 'self'
  distDir - ../src-web/index.html
  devPath - ../src-web/index.html
```

From the event viewer log of the win system, we can see that the exception from user32.dll.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8541016/125038771-a7105800-e04a-11eb-9b2c-8c861e74aa63.png)

body:
I've run into this as well… the solution for me was to [unplug](https://yarnpkg.com/cli/unplug) the `@tauri-apps/cli` package.
I guess you don't play well with yarn's PNP
I also encountered the same problem, it will download rust cli when run 'yarn tauri dev' each time?

> I've run into this as well… the solution for me was to [unplug](https://yarnpkg.com/cli/unplug) the `@tauri-apps/cli` package.
> I guess you don't play well with yarn's PNP

This didn't work for me. `yarn tauri init` works just fine. But `yarn tauri:serve` fails. The last manage I get is `Downloading Rust CLI...` (which has already been downloaded due to `yarn tauri init`). After that, the process exits.
